statements.statement: The member presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The symptoms are concerning for potential arrhythmia
The member has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
CPT code 93229 (mobile cardiac telemetry) was ordered
The service was ordered to correlate symptomatic events with cardiac rhythm disturbances over an extended monitoring period
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial was based on lack of required precertification or authorization prior to service delivery
